statement: At final strength λ = xp∗ , with (χlin, χe) = (1, 0), the direct and smoothed systems satisfy (P11), uniformly with the same parameters γ, ℓ. Their scalar trial gaps fspin(K) + 1 4 Z b−1 (K − h)2 dv − f0 m, where fspin is the self-corrected one-site pressure at the corresponding terminal mass, also differ by O(x5+c). The same fixed c > 0 works for these three comparisons, independently of the site count.
